title: A series you could not stop watching
context_es: Una web en inglés sobre series y películas pide reseñas a sus lectores.
prompt_en:
You see this announcement on an English-language website:

Reviews wanted!
Have you watched a TV series recently that you could not stop watching? Write a review of the series. Tell us what it is about, what you liked or disliked, and who you would recommend it to.

Write your review.
points: say what the series is about
explain what you liked or disliked
say who you would recommend it to
useful_language: The series is set in / on …
I would highly recommend it to anyone who …
tips_es: Una reseña informa y opina: un párrafo para presentar, uno o dos para valorar y uno final para recomendar.
Cuenta el argumento en presente (*The story follows…*) y usa vocabulario de valoración: *gripping, predictable, superb*.
No hace falta que la serie exista (la de la respuesta modelo es inventada): se valora tu inglés, no el dato.
model_answer:
Low Tide: a mystery you will not forget

If you enjoy crime stories that make you think, Low Tide is the series for you. I started watching it one rainy Sunday and finished all eight episodes in three days.

The series is set on a small Scottish island where everybody knows each other. When a young teacher disappears, a detective from the mainland arrives to investigate, and she soon discovers that nobody is telling the whole truth. Without giving too much away, the ending is completely unexpected.

What impressed me most was the atmosphere. The grey sea, the empty roads and the slow music create a feeling of tension from the first scene. The acting is also superb, especially the actor who plays the teacher's father. My only criticism is that the middle episodes are rather slow, although I never wanted to stop watching.

All in all, Low Tide is intelligent, beautifully filmed and impossible to predict. I would highly recommend it to anyone who prefers a good plot to explosions. However, if you are looking for fast action, this is probably not the right choice.
